components.css: .ds-status-plate { border: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(255, 255, 227, 0.14)); border-radius: 12px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg, #0E100F) 55%, var(--surface, #161916)); padding: 0.35rem 1.15rem; max-width: 340px; font-family: var(--font, 'Hanken Grotesk', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); color: var(--ink, #FFFFE3); } .ds-status-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1.25rem; padding: 0.85rem 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--line, rgba(255, 255, 227, 0.14)); font-size: 0.9rem; } .ds-status-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; } .ds-status-row span:first-child { color: var(--muted, #9A9A8A); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; font-size: 0.78rem; } .ds-status-row span:last-child { text-align: right; font-weight: 600; } .ds-status-busy { color: var(--busy, #FF3B3B); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 0.5rem; line-height: 1; } .ds-busy-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; flex-shrink: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--busy, #FF3B3B); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(255, 59, 59, 0.55); animation: ds-busy-glow 1.8s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-busy-glow { 0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(255, 59, 59, 0.55); } 70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 8px rgba(255, 59, 59, 0); } 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(255, 59, 59, 0); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-busy-dot { animation: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255, 59, 59, 0.28); } }

narrative.overview:
A hireability-first systems portfolio that borrows craft materials from thegr8binil.me (near-black field, faint grid, cream ink, signal blue, Hanken Grotesk, pill chrome) without cloning that site's stage lockup. The composition is left-led: the name is the display signal, the bio and CTAs sit under it, circular icon reach-outs finish the left column, and a right-hand status plate holds ROLE / STACK / BASE / STATUS for a recruiter scan.

The field is dark-only. Depth comes from hairline rules, dashed separators, a soft surface mix on the status plate, and restrained motion (hero fade-up, busy glow pulse, hover nudge). Contact is direct email plus copy. There is no footer, no theme toggle, no fake forms or metrics.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black canvas with a masked 48px grid and cream ink
Single family: Hanken Grotesk from display through labels
Pill chrome at 44px for nav, CTAs, and icon links; 12px radius for plates and photo
Left-led hero name + right status plate (Busy red glow pulse)
Ruled project rows with a quieter dashed secondary block (Also on GitHub)

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal blue is the only interactive accent for links, CTAs, and focus. Busy red is STATUS-only.

rules.name: The Dark Field Rule
rules.body: The system is dark-only. Do not introduce a light theme or invert the cream-on-near-black relationship.

rules.name: The Single Face Rule
rules.body: Do not add a display serif, mono, or second sans. Hierarchy is weight and size only.

rules.name: The Name Is Display Rule
rules.body: The hero brand signal is the person's name at display scale. Do not demote the name to an eyebrow or replace it with a slogan lockup.

rules.name: The Left-Led Hero Rule
rules.body: First viewport: name, one lead, one CTA pair, icon row, status plate. No centered stage lockup, floating meta comments, or absolute email pills on the hero.

rules.name: The Projects Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Projects → Selected work (featured ruled rows) → Also on GitHub (dashed separator, quieter recent rows, same hover nudge).

rules.name: The Hairline Depth Rule
rules.body: Prefer 1px cream hairlines and dashed dividers over card shadows. Lift is hover motion (1px up or 3px nudge), not layered umbras.

rules.name: The Pill Chrome Rule
rules.body: Interactive chrome shares --pill-h: 44px and pill radius. Do not invent a third radius family for buttons or nav.

rules.name: The Busy Glow Rule
rules.body: STATUS uses busy red + expanding glow pulse. Do not reuse live green as an availability blinker on this plate.

dos: Do keep the name as the hero display signal and the status plate as the right-hand scan summary.
Do reuse pill chrome at 44px height and surface radius 12px for plates/photo.
Do keep projects as Selected work then Also on GitHub, with the dashed separator marking secondary rank.
Do route contact through real email (tanuvnair@gmail.com) with copy-to-clipboard.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion by dropping hero entrance and freezing the busy glow.
donts: Don't restore a centered SOFTWARE / ENGINEER / SYSTEMS stage lockup or Binil layout clone.
Don't add light mode, theme toggle, footer, contact forms, or fake metrics.
Don't put floating // comment meta, absolute email pills on the hero, or numbered Focus 01-04 chrome.
Don't use Connect-style live green blinkers for STATUS; Busy is red glow only.
Don't introduce a second typeface or card-heavy dashboard density on the first viewport.
